author: The Q
description:
Get a first look at Anker eufyMake’s unreleased 2-in-1 Personal Fabric Printer at IFA 2026. I tested its DTG and DTF printing, explored what it can create, and even printed one of our own designs. This is an early prototype, so some details may still change before launch.

Join the exclusive Fabric Printer Co-Create Group for a chance to become a beta tester, share your ideas, help shape the product, and get the latest updates.
Join Now 👉  https://eufymake.io/3kybD9

Get a first look at Anker eufyMake’s next-gen DTF & DTG 2-in-1 Personal Fabric Printer at IFA 2026.
Learn More 👉 https://eufymake.io/3Y7s4m
title: Now Anyone Can Print Clothes at Home?! 👕🔥 IFA 2026 Berlin #ifa #eufymake #ifa2026
